mo_ta_cong_viec:
Be part of a multinational team of engineers responsible for developing software for automotive Telematics Control Unit products.
Technologies used: Embedded C, CAN, OSEK, RTOS, GSM, 3G/4G, AT commands.
 
• Lead CI operations and manage the software integration testing and integration team for an automotive platform project.
• Develop software in accordance with ASPICE standards.
• Verify software requirements at component and bench levels.
• Apply knowledge of white, grey, and black box testing methodologies.
• Support functional disciplines in all software-related aspects.
• Independently design, implement, and test software components as a skilled software engineer.
• Perform intermediate to advanced software engineering tasks aimed at achieving full technical competence.
• Configure, implement, and automate Continuous Integration/Delivery pipelines, including test automation frameworks.
• Continuously enhance the speed, efficiency, scalability, and stability of the continuous integration system and environment.
• Develop software following standard guidelines and safety requirements.
• Maintain consistent and reliable attendance.
• Utilize static code analysis techniques, including familiarity with MISRA standards.
